traceability.notes: Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS is fully implemented. All specified requirements (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-UPDATE, REQ-MAINT-BATCH, REQ-MAINT-VERIFY, REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE) have concrete implementations in src/maintenance/* and are covered by focused unit tests, CLI integration tests, and performance tests, all explicitly tagged to this story. The CLI (traceability-maint) provides detection, verification, reporting, and update commands with clear, user-friendly output, JSON modes for tooling, distinct exit codes, and dry-run behavior, satisfying the core functionality, integration, user experience, safety, and quality criteria. README documents the maintenance CLI with commands and usage examples, meeting the documentation acceptance criterion. All related Jest test suites pass, providing strong evidence that the story’s acceptance criteria are met.
